اعتمرتم (form VIII)
# اِعْتَمَرْتُمْ (iʕtamartum) /iʕ.ta.mar.tum/: second-person masculine plural past active of اِعْتَمَرَ (iʕtamara)
# اُعْتُمِرْتُمْ (uʕtumirtum) /uʕ.tu.mir.tum/: second-person masculine plural past passive of اِعْتَمَرَ (iʕtamara)
